Frequently Asked Questions

Is Hamdard better than Malir?

Both Hamdard University and Malir University of Science and Technology are HEC-recognized universities. Hamdard is private (est. 1991) in Karachi, while Malir is private (est. 2022) in Karachi. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between Hamdard and Malir?

Hamdard's fee is approximately Rs. 80–150K/sem per semester, while Malir's is Free of cost (Tuition-free) / One-time fees only. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for Hamdard and Malir?

Hamdard: 65%+ in FSc. Malir: Minimum 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent (A-Levels, etc.) from a recognized board. Foreign qualifications require IBCC equivalency certificate.
